input_text: Explain the 2. Background section of the Attention Is All You Need research paper.
target_text: Before the Transformer, sequence-processing tasks commonly used RNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs. These models process words one after another, which makes parallel processing difficult and increases training time, especially for long sequences. Attention mechanisms were already being used to help models understand relationships between words, but they were generally combined with recurrent networks. The Transformer was proposed to remove this sequential dependency and use self-attention to directly connect different positions in a sequence. This makes it easier to learn long-distance relationships and allows much greater parallelization.
